text.ms:
1. Peraturan-peraturan ini bolehlah dinamakan Peraturan-Peraturan

Makanan Haiwan (Kesalahan Boleh Kompaun) 2019.

Kesalahan boleh kompaun

2. Kesalahan yang dinyatakan dalam Jadual ditetapkan sebagai kesalahan

boleh kompaun.

JADUAL

[Peraturan 2]

KESALAHAN BOLEH KOMPAUN

Kesalahan yang berikut ditetapkan sebagai kesalahan boleh kompaun:

(a) Kesalahan yang dilakukan di bawah peruntukan Akta Makanan Haiwan 2009

seperti yang berikut:

(i) subseksyen 38(2);

(ii) subseksyen 39(2);

(b) Kesalahan yang dilakukan di bawah subperaturan 6(3) Peraturan-Peraturan

Makanan Haiwan (Kaedah Menganalisis Makanan Haiwan dan Bentuk

Perakuan Analisis) 2012 [P.U. (A) 254/2012];

(c) Kesalahan yang dilakukan di bawah peruntukan Peraturan-Peraturan

Makanan Haiwan (Lesen untuk Mengimport Makanan Haiwan atau

Bahan Tambahan Makanan Haiwan) 2012 [P.U. (A) 256/2012] seperti

yang berikut:

(i) subperaturan 3(1);

(ii) subperaturan 10(1);

(iii) peraturan 11;

(d) Kesalahan yang dilakukan di bawah subperaturan 3(2) Peraturan-Peraturan

Makanan Haiwan (Antibiotik, Hormon dan Bahan Kimia Lain Terlarang) 2012

[P.U. (A) 272/2012]; dan

(e) Kesalahan yang dilakukan di bawah peruntukan Peraturan-Peraturan

Makanan Haiwan (Pembuatan dan Penjualan Makanan Haiwan atau Bahan

Tambahan Makanan Haiwan) 2012 [P.U. (A) 312/2012] seperti yang berikut:

(i) subperaturan 3(1);

(ii) peraturan 9;

(iii) subperaturan 11(1);

(iv) peraturan 13.

Dibuat 18 September 2019

[KP/LA/483/20 JLD.2; PN(PU2)702/IV]

 DATO' SALAHUDDIN BIN AYUB

 Menteri Pertanian dan Industri Asas Tani

FEED ACT 2009

FEED (COMPOUNDABLE OFFENCES) REGULATIONS 2019

IN exercise of the powers conferred by paragraph 53(2)(k) of the Feed Act 2009

[Act 698], the Minister, after consulting the Board, makes the following regulations:

Citation and commencement

1. These regulations may be cited as the Feed (Compoundable Offences)

Regulations 2019.

Compoundable offences

2. The offences specified in the Schedule are prescribed as

compoundable offences.

SCHEDULE

[Regulation 2]

COMPOUNDABLE OFFENCES

The following offences are prescribed as compoundable offences:

(a) the offences committed under provisions of the Feed Act 2009 as follows:

(i) subsection 38(2);

(ii) subsection 39(2);

(b) the offences committed under subregulation 6(3) of the Feed

(Methods of Analysis of Feed and the Form of Certificate of Analysis)

Regulations 2012 [P.U. (A) 254/2012];

(c) the offences committed under provisions of the Feed (Licence to Import

Feed or Feed Additive) Regulations 2012 [P.U. (A) 256/2012] as follows:

(i) subregulation 3(1);

(ii) subregulation 10(1);

(iii) regulation 11;

(d) the offences committed under subregulation 3(2) of the Feed (Prohibited

Antibiotics, Hormones and Other Chemicals) Regulations 2012

[P.U. (A) 272/2012];

(e) the offences committed under provisions of the Feed (Manufacture and

Sale of Feed or Feed Additive) Regulations 2012 [P.U. (A) 312/2012]

as follows:

(i) subregulation 3(1);

(ii) regulation 9;

(iii) subregulation 11(1);

(iv) regulation 13.

Made 18 September 2019

[KP/LA/483/20 JLD.2; PN(PU2)702/IV]

 DATO' SALAHUDDIN BIN AYUB

 Minister of Agriculture and Agro-based Industry
